class.name: MeshPainter
class.brief_description: Paints textures on a mesh, unwraps and edits its UVs, and gives its faces materials.
class.description: The engine side of the Mesh Paint tool (the [b]Paint[/b] button in the 3D editor's toolbar when a [MeshInstance3D] is selected). [method load_mesh] reads any [Mesh] into a list of triangles. Every face belongs to a material slot (one per surface to begin with), and faces joined by shared UV edges form UV islands. You can unwrap new UVs with [method smart_unwrap], place islands again with [method pack_islands], move islands with [method transform_faces_uv], select faces, and move faces to other slots. [method commit_mesh] gives back a plain [ArrayMesh] with one surface per slot, so a painted mesh costs nothing extra at runtime. Painting writes into RGBA8 [Image]s through the mesh's UVs: [method paint_dab] uses a 3D brush (a sphere around a point on the surface, so strokes continue across UV seams), [method paint_dab_uv] paints straight in UV space, and [method fill_faces] fills faces. Group dabs between [method begin_stroke] and [method end_stroke]; the stroke keeps the untouched image for undo. [codeblock] var painter = MeshPainter.new() painter.load_mesh($Body.mesh) if not painter.has_uvs(): painter.smart_unwrap() var material = StandardMaterial3D.new() var image = MeshPainter.make_channel_image(material, MeshPainter.CHANNEL_ALBEDO, Vector2i(1024, 1024)) var brush = MeshPaintBrush.new() brush.color = Color.RED var hit = painter.intersect_ray(Vector3(0, 1, 3), Vector3(0, 0, -1)) painter.begin_stroke() painter.paint_dab(image, brush, hit.position, 0.1, Vector3(0, 1, 3), Vector3.UP) painter.end_stroke() MeshPainter.set_channel_texture(material, MeshPainter.CHANNEL_ALBEDO, ImageTexture.create_from_image(image)) painter.set_slot_material(0, material) $Body.mesh = painter.commit_mesh() [/codeblock] All positions are in the mesh's local space. Unwrapping and packing need the [code]xatlas_unwrap[/code] module.

method.name: add_slot
method.description: Adds a material slot and returns its index. No faces use it until [method set_faces_slot].

method.name: begin_stroke
method.description: Starts a stroke. Dabs until [method end_stroke] never paint a texel stronger than the strongest dab that touched it.

method.name: commit_mesh
method.description: Builds an [ArrayMesh] with one surface per slot that has faces, keeping normals, colours, UV2, custom channels, skin weights and blend shapes. Tangents are made again when the UVs changed. If [param generate_lods] is [code]true[/code] and the loaded mesh had LODs, LODs are generated again. Faces are put in slot order, so loading the result back keeps face indices.

method.name: end_stroke
method.description: Ends the stroke started by [method begin_stroke]. Call [method get_stroke_images], [method get_stroke_rect] and [method get_stroke_original] before it to record undo.

method.name: fill_faces
method.description: Fills [param faces] in [param image] with the brush colour, at the brush strength and blend mode.

method.name: get_aabb
method.description: Returns the bounds of the faces.

method.name: get_barycentric
method.description: Returns the barycentric coordinates of [param point] in [param face].

method.name: get_channel_texture
method.description: Returns the texture a material uses for [param channel].

method.name: get_face_count
method.description: Returns the number of triangles.

method.name: get_face_island
method.description: Returns the UV island of [param face].

method.name: get_face_normal
method.description: Returns the face's normal (out of its front side).

method.name: get_face_piece
method.description: Returns the piece of [param face]: faces joined by edges in 3D, whatever their UVs.

method.name: get_face_position
method.description: Returns the position of one of the face's corners ([param corner] is 0, 1 or 2). With a pose mesh, this is the posed position.

method.name: get_face_slot
method.description: Returns the material slot of [param face].

method.name: get_face_uv
method.description: Returns the UV of one of the face's corners.

method.name: get_face_uvs
method.description: Returns the UVs of all faces, three per face.

method.name: get_faces_in_sphere
method.description: Returns the faces that touch the sphere. With [param front_only], only faces turned toward [param eye] and not hidden behind other faces are returned.

method.name: get_faces_triangles
method.description: Returns the corners of [param faces], three per face, moved [param offset] along their normals. Useful for drawing a selection.

method.name: get_island_count
method.description: Returns the number of UV islands.

method.name: get_island_faces
method.description: Returns the faces of [param island].

method.name: get_island_uv_rect
method.description: Returns the UV bounds of [param island].

method.name: get_islands_of_faces
method.description: Returns the islands [param faces] belong to, each once.

method.name: get_loaded_mesh
method.description: Returns the mesh given to [method load_mesh].

method.name: get_piece_faces
method.description: Returns the faces of [param piece].

method.name: get_selected_face_count
method.description: Returns how many faces are selected.

method.name: get_selected_faces
method.description: Returns the selected faces.

method.name: get_slot_count
method.description: Returns the number of material slots.

method.name: get_slot_face_count
method.description: Returns how many faces use [param slot].

method.name: get_slot_faces
method.description: Returns the faces that use [param slot].

method.name: get_slot_material
method.description: Returns the material of [param slot].

method.name: get_slot_name
method.description: Returns the name of [param slot]; it becomes the surface name.

method.name: get_stroke_images
method.description: Returns the images painted during the current stroke.

method.name: get_stroke_original
method.description: Returns [param image] as it was when the stroke started painting it.

method.name: get_stroke_rect
method.description: Returns the area of [param image] painted during the current stroke.

method.name: get_uv_at
method.description: Returns the UV at a point of [param face] given by [param barycentric].

method.name: grow_selection
method.description: Adds the faces that share a corner with the selection.

method.name: has_uvs
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if every surface had UVs, or UVs were made since.

method.name: intersect_ray
method.description: Casts a ray at the faces. Returns an empty [Dictionary] on a miss, else [code]face[/code], [code]position[/code], [code]normal[/code] and [code]barycentric[/code].

method.name: invert_selection
method.description: Selects the faces that were not selected, and the other way round.

method.name: is_face_selected
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param face] is selected.

method.name: load_mesh
method.description: Loads [param mesh]. Line and point surfaces are kept as they are. [param pose_mesh] (for example from [method MeshInstance3D.bake_mesh_from_current_skeleton_pose]) gives the positions the brush and picking use, so a posed character is painted where it shows. [param surface_overrides] are used as the slot materials where set.

method.name: make_channel_image
method.description: Returns an RGBA8 image holding what [param material] shows today for [param channel]: its texture times its value, or just the value. An untiled texture keeps its own size; otherwise the image is [param size], with the material's UV1 tiling baked in.

method.name: pack_islands
method.description: Places the islands again inside the square, [param padding] texels apart at [param resolution]. With [param average_scale], every island first gets the same texel density.

method.name: paint_dab
method.description: Paints one dab of [param brush] into [param image] around [param center], [param radius] wide, on faces of [param slot] ([code]-1[/code] for all). [param eye] is where the view comes from (for back faces, occlusion and the stamp's facing) and [param up] the view's up direction. Returns the area painted.

method.name: paint_dab_uv
method.description: Paints one dab into [param image] at [param uv], with [param radius] in UV units. Returns the area painted.

method.name: remove_slot
method.description: Removes [param slot]; its faces go to the first other slot.

method.name: sample_image
method.description: Returns the colour of [param image] at a point of [param face].

method.name: select_all
method.description: Selects all faces, or none if [param select] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: select_islands_of_selection
method.description: Grows the selection to whole UV islands.

method.name: select_pieces_of_selection
method.description: Grows the selection to whole pieces (faces joined in 3D).

method.name: set_channel_texture
method.description: Gives [param material] [param texture] for [param channel] and makes the material's own value neutral (white albedo, roughness and metallic of 1, white multiplied emission), since the painted texture holds the final value. UV1 tiling is turned off.

method.name: set_face_selected
method.description: Selects or deselects [param face].

method.name: set_faces_slot
method.description: Moves [param faces] to [param slot].

method.name: set_pose_mesh
method.description: Changes the positions the brush and picking use, from a mesh with the same layout as the loaded one.

method.name: set_selected_faces
method.description: Selects exactly [param faces].

method.name: set_slot_material
method.description: Sets the material of [param slot].

method.name: set_slot_name
method.description: Sets the name of [param slot].

method.name: shrink_selection
method.description: Removes selected faces that share a corner with unselected ones.

method.name: smart_unwrap
method.description: Makes new UVs. Faces split into islands at angles over [param angle_limit] degrees, and an island never spans two slots. With [param faces], only those faces are unwrapped: they get the texel density of the rest and everything is packed again.

method.name: transform_faces_uv
method.description: Transforms the UVs of [param faces] (move, rotate or scale islands).

constants.constant: Represents the size of the [enum Channel] enum.
